# identity.ApiKey

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A scoped API key (service principal) owned by a user of the organization; no secret.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.ApiKey` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.api-key.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the key was created (UTC). |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | When the key stops working (UTC); at most 365 days after creation. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | API key id. |  |
| `lastUsedAt` | yes | `none` | Last successful use, updated at most once a minute (UTC). |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Name given by the owner. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the key is limited to; it acts only there and below. |  |
| `ownerUid` | yes | `personal` | User who created and owns the key. |  |
| `publicId` | yes | `none` | Public, non-secret part of the key, to recognize it in lists. |  |
| `revokedReason` | no | `none` | Why the key was revoked. |  |
| `scopes` | yes | `none` | Permissions the key may use; always intersected with the owner's current grants. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `revoked` keys answer 401. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization the key acts in. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the key last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
